name: QFL base cracking

source.label: Quickfingers Luc's base-cracking method, with Gainium's QFL Base Scanner defaults and the bot form's Mid-term safety-order preset

rules: Find a base: the lowest low of the last 36 hourly candles, confirmed when price bounces 3% above it within 8 candles.
Buy when price cracks 3% below that base.
Average down with up to 8 safety orders, the first 2% lower, each 1.15 times further and 1.5 times larger than the one before.
Sell the whole position 3% above its average price.
Hold one position per coin at a time, with no stop loss.
notExpressed: Choosing bases by eye on the chart (the scanner finds them by rule)
